screen.volatility_formula: sample_std(close_t/close_tminus1-1 over current20)*sqrt(252); 21 consecutive positive finite closes; excludes corporate action adjustment
screen.listing_age_rule: calendar open sessions since listing effective_from; start clipped to 2019 for older listings, guaranteed >=120 before first decision
screen.next_open_rule: next open calendar_session joined by venue; valid listing/security [from,to), positive finite open, tradable and can_buy true, positive finite upper limit, open < upper-0.005
screen.unknown_rule: missing/invalid required input blocks admission; disjoint ordered reason ledger
screen.control: baseline AND finite momentum20 outside original closed band

decision.consumer: Next research allocator deciding whether this fixed raw-momentum band deserves a costed-replay tranche
decision.primary_metric: mean of same-date same-venue disjoint candidate-control next-session open-to-close response differences

branches.insufficient: inconclusive; park without changing the sample or thresholds
branches.advance: supported for a costed-replay candidate only when mean increment >=5bp, each year >0 and 95pct bootstrap lower >0
branches.below_minimum: not_met when the 95pct bootstrap upper is below 5bp; park this fixed band in this use
branches.uncertain: inconclusive otherwise; park pending a genuinely new question or material evidence

exposure.predecessor: R1 v2 A2/A4 and all earlier same-window studies; retained
exposure.question_delta: Adds a previously unevaluated future intraday price-response label and disjoint ablation of the fixed momentum band; no fit, threshold grid or fresh-holdout claim
exposure.recompute_reason: One newly authorized R2 study; original R1 package and conclusions retained

analysis.consumer: Next research allocator deciding whether this fixed raw-momentum band deserves a costed-replay tranche
analysis.question: Holding all other R1 filters fixed, does momentum20 in [0.02,0.12] add next-session open-to-close price response against the disjoint out-of-band group?
analysis.baseline: R1 universe and all original filters except momentum band; finite momentum required
analysis.candidate: baseline AND momentum20 in original closed [0.02,0.12] band
analysis.control: baseline AND finite momentum20 outside original closed band
analysis.label: next-session unadjusted close / open - 1; positive finite prices, same next-open price guard; a descriptive response label
analysis.aggregation: Equal-weight listings within each date/venue/group; candidate minus disjoint control; mean the two venue differences within each paired date, then equal-weight paired dates
analysis.minimum_mean_increment_rationale: 5bp is a preregistered routing threshold for funding a later costed replay, not a net return or execution gate

bootstrap.method: year-stratified circular moving blocks of paired dates

decision_branches.uncertain: inconclusive otherwise; park pending a genuinely new question or material evidence

independent_check.scope: independently rebuilt pandas/numpy feature and next-session joins plus paired summaries; no producer SQL import

analysis.claim_ceiling: Latest-sealed 2020-2021 descriptive incremental signal screen. Next-session intraday price response is not an executable same-day round trip; no strategy economic adoption, training or protected partition activation.
